ca94085c07.why: The final subtraction writes only unpreserved ymm1 after the required ymm0 result has been computed.

9272e57d68.why: The rounded second vector and shifted shuffle mask are live alongside the packed result, so the rounding and rearrangement stages remain necessary.

6c714cc7cb.why: The only preserved vector is ymm0, whose final value is the CONST_3 broadcast with its upper half zeroed by the VEX instruction. All other vector calculations and loads are dead.

00958c8134.why: Both permutation tables and both permuted vectors are required, and AVX2 VPERMD cannot take its index vector from memory.

5bb019f142.why: The split rounding that avoids overflow, cross-lane permutations, and 18-bit clamps are required along with the preserved intermediate vectors and constants.

8e2594c447.why: The full 32-bit modular products, rounded corrections, and original permuted data are all needed by preserved final registers.

ffa13a7bca.why: Each live result requires its multiply, rounding add, and arithmetic shift, with both broadcast constants also live.
